body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## PROJECT DOCS (2026-07-26) — keep alive
- **`ARCHITECTURE.md`** (mod root): the living map — layered dependency graph, boot/lifecycle sequence, the "ONE BIG MAP" request-interception pattern, per-module reference table, cross-cutting patterns, refactor backlog. USER-OWNED; update it in the same change as any structural shift. Diagrams are Mermaid. §9 records R1–R4 DONE and R5 as a standing non-split.
- **`docs/generate-helicopter-view.sh`** → `docs/HELICOPTER_VIEW.md` (gitignored, ~1.9 MB): concatenates the whole codebase into one md for whole-project chats. Regenerate before such a chat.
- **Metrics:** 165 C# files / ~42.5k LOC + 14 Defs/Patches XML ≈ **43.9k LOC**. 110 declarative `Patch_*` + 24 imperative compat patches. 19 `ABGuard` kill switches. Largest files `Logistics/CrossLevelDemand.cs` (1,489) + `Rendering/LevelRenderer.cs` (1,260) — left intact (R5).
- **Architecture spine:** `Levels/LevelExtensions.cs` (`map.Levels()`/`GroundMap()`/`SameColumn()`) most-depended-on; `Core/ABGuard` second; `Levels/LevelCensus` holds the tier-1 static perf gates; `Core/ABGameHooks` the game-tick registry; `Compat/ABCompat` the compat registry.

## REFACTOR PASS R1–R4 (2026-07-26, behavior-preserving, green 0/0) — awaiting in-game regression pass
- **R1 — `Core/ABGameHooks.cs`:** reflection-discovered game-lifecycle registry. Features annotate `[ABGameTick(order)]`/`[ABGameReset]`/`[ABGameExpose]`; `ABGameComp` runs `RunTicks/RunResets/RunExposes`. Deterministic order, zero per-tick alloc. 6 tick / 7 reset / 1 expose — matches the old explicit list exactly (order preserved: ritual10→climb20→supply30→pendingOrders40→hospitality50→neutralExit60). Startup verbose log: `[AB] Game hooks discovered: 6 tick, 7 reset, 1 expose.` LevelComp's map-tick loop deliberately NOT genericized (heterogeneous scheduling on perf-critical MapComponent).
- **R2 — `ABDevTools` split:** monolith → core file + 7 domain partials (`.Combat/.Movement/.Systems/.Levels/.Rendering/.Threats/.Logistics.cs`). Byte-identical bodies, 22 DebugActions preserved.
- **R3 — `LevelComp` split:** `Levels/LevelCensus.cs` (new) owns static gates (`AnySky/AnyBasement/AnyLevelColumns` + `NoteLevel`); scheduler+sync → `Levels/LevelComp.Scheduler.cs`; `LevelComp.cs` = model. ~30 gate call sites now `LevelCensus.*`.
- **R4 — `Compat/ABCompat.cs`:** central audit registry; all 27 detections route through `ABCompat.Detect`/`.Note`. `ABCompat.Setup()` is the standardized boot for new bridges. Dev action **"AB: list compat modules"** dumps state (Absent/Present/Active/Failed). Existing bespoke boots kept (each foreign mod needs a different probe).
- **R5 — DO NOT SPLIT `CrossLevelDemand`/`LevelRenderer`** (cohesive, not churning).

## PERF — GC MICRO-PASS #2/#4 (2026-07-26)
Audited hot paths for allocating LINQ (#2) and enumerator boxing (#4). **Finding: hot paths were already clean** — pawn scans use indexed `for` over `IReadOnlyList<Pawn>` (boxing-free), and `foreach`es are over `HashSet`/`Dictionary`/`CellRect` (struct enumerators). **#4: no safe change** — the only lever was a fragile `IReadOnlyList<Pawn>`→`List<Pawn>` downcast (`AllPawnsSpawned`'s property type is the interface; downcast risks `InvalidCastException` if Ludeon wraps it), deliberately NOT made. **#2: 3 safe warm-path removals applied** — `ABHospitalityCompat` guest-scan `AllComps.Any(capturing lambda)` → manual `for` (kills a closure+delegate alloc per building); `PawnTablePatches` (×2) + `ABAnimalTabCompat` `MapByLevel.OrderByDescending(k=>k.Key)` → allocation-free `for (int lvl=1; lvl>=-1; lvl--)` + `TryGetValue` (relies on the hard 3-level cap; runs on table/tab rebuild). Green 0/0. Remaining LINQ is confined to cold paths (level-gen, trade dialogs, init, level deletion) — left as-is (clearer there). Lesson saved to performance lore.

## TESTING RULE
isolated=true always. Companions: **always `astryl.ModernDevTools`**; **NOT Melee Animation**; add `Mehni.PickUpAndHaul` for bulk. Build a column via "As above\\AB: ensure sky + basement" — **the pin gets culled at startup ("Could not find node… Removing", harmless RimWorld quirk for Playing-gated debug actions); run it from the Debug Actions menu instead**. Diagnostics: **"AB: explain haul decision"** (ToolMap), **"AB: list compat modules"** (R4).

## PERF — TIER-1 STATIC GATES (pass 42; gates in LevelCensus since R3)
Global cheap gates live on `LevelCensus`, keyed to the current `Game` via a `WeakReference` (stale count reads false, never wrong): `AnySkyLevels`, `AnyBasementLevels`, `AnyLevelColumns` (= sky||basement count > 0). Counts maintained by `LevelComp.FinalizeInit`/`MapRemoved` via `LevelCensus.NoteLevel(lvl, delta)`. Each hot cross-level patch's FIRST check is `if (!LevelCensus.AnyLevelColumns …) return;` — a superset of every patch's real precondition, so strictly behavior-preserving; in a zero-column game the patch bails on one static int read before touching the per-map `Levels()` CWT lookup. **Build B, NOT physical unpatch** (DrawPosOffsetPatcher patches hundreds of getters on ParallelPreDraw worker threads; re-emit poisoning risk). Gated hot set ~27 entry points. NOT gated (event-driven): click/drag selection, area setter, trade/caravan/ritual-gather/incident-divert.

## LEVEL NAVIGATION / INPUT
Manual level switching funnels through `LevelCamera.JumpPreservingView(Map)` (preserves camera pos+zoom, selection, open Architect tool; `ManualSwitch=true` bypasses the camera level lock). Inputs in `ABGameComp.GameComponentOnGUI` (before `CameraDriverOnGUI`):
- **`AB_ViewLevelUp`/`Down`** (PageUp/PageDown), rebindable, category `AB_Keys`. VERIFIED.
- **`AB_CameraLevelLock`** (End) — toggles `LevelCamera.LevelLocked` (AUTOMATIC switches only). Gated by `cameraLockKeybind`.
- **Left CTRL + mouse wheel over the map** = move up/down. Gated by `scrollLevelKeybind`. Skips over windows. **WHY CTRL NOT SHIFT:** Shift+wheel is rerouted onto the horizontal axis by OS/Unity IMGUI, zeroing the vertical wheel (killed two Shift attempts, and vanilla zoom too). Reads `Input.mouseScrollDelta.y`, frame-stamped, consumes the ScrollWheel event. Verbose: `[AB] ctrl+wheel <val> -> <target>`.

## STAIRS FLOAT MENU — single "go up/down" order (2026-07-26 fix)
CANONICAL = `Building_ABStairs.BuildUseOptions` ("Go up/down the stairs" + greyed reasons). The postfix `CrossLevelOrders.AddStairsTravelOption` now yields to the base option (skips when an existing label `==` OR StartsWith `AB_GoUp`/`AB_GoDown`), so "via X" survives only as a fallback. Elevators covered. Awaiting retest.

## ART — stair/ladder/elevator texture pass (2026-07-26, MORTON)
External retexture pack (`Textures/Things/Building/AB_*`) + MORTON graphic settings grafted into `Defs/Buildings/AB_Stairs.xml` (texture only, gameplay preserved). 27 files, directional (+dedicated stair `_west`), single uiIcon icons. Stale `AB_Elevator_AB_Elevator.png` removed.

## PUBLISH STATE (2026-07-26)
Workshop UPDATE (PublishedFileId `3767572810`). Green 0/0. Hygiene: stubs.json empty, no pdb, no shipped 0Harmony.dll, Assemblies only `AsAboveSoBelow.dll`, About.xml complete. NOTE: the R1–R4 refactor + GC micro-pass are NOT yet published — green but need an in-game regression pass first.

## PASS 41 — COLUMN STORAGE INDEX + DOCTRINE B (consumables)
**CORE:** `StoreUtility.TryFindBestBetterStorageFor(item, carrier:null, map, ...)` runs vanilla's full storage search (Harmony-patched by LWM/Adaptive Storage). `ColumnStorage.TryFindBetter` runs it on every level, crosses only for a strictly-higher tier elsewhere. **DOCTRINE B:** consumables follow one-big-map STORAGE priority into the best stockpile, fetched CROSS-LEVEL AT USE TIME. Only ACTIVE location-specific work pre-positions a stack. MOBILE pawns register no pull. **Phase 3/4 PENDING.**

## VERIFIED (USER)
RMB cross-level · basement · mech charge · p33 see-below · p36 work priority · p36b aim pose · p40 chunk designation gate · p40 multi-hop relay UPWARD · p40 pull-side fetch · **PageUp/PageDown level nav**.

## Compat
Pick Up And Haul / Hauler's Dream · **LWM Deep Storage + Adaptive Storage Framework** · DBH/VEF/Rimefeller · Odyssey · Misc. Robots · Allow Tool · CE (p38) · CAI 5000 (p39) · INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta, Strata · UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded.

## STANDING TEST QUEUE
- **REFACTOR R1–R4 + GC micro-pass (retest, HIGH PRIORITY):** the whole point is nothing changed. (a) R1: build a column; confirm ALL game-tick features still fire — ritual gather, climb-emerge cleanup, construct supply retry, routed-order self-heal on arrival, Hospitality guest roaming, stranded-NPC exit; new game AND after save/load. Startup verbose: `[AB] Game hooks discovered: 6 tick, 7 reset, 1 expose.` (b) R3: perf gates still work (no column → all vanilla; column → every cross-level feature fires). (c) R4: **"AB: list compat modules"** with integrated mods loaded → Present/Active; unloaded → Absent. (d) #2: pawn tables (Work/Restrict/Assign/Animals) still show all levels' colonists/animals in sky→ground→basement order; Hospitality guests still find vendors/guest beds across levels.
- **STAIRS FLOAT MENU (retest):** RMB colonist → RMB stuffed stairwell → exactly ONE "Go up the stairs". Down/ladders/elevators. Forbid → single greyed "(forbidden)"; wall off → single greyed "(no path)".
- **INPUT (ctrl+scroll):** Left Ctrl + scroll over map moves level, no zoom; plain scroll zooms; over a window scrolls the window; ends at top/bottom; toggle off in View tab; works with camera lock ON.
- **ART:** build each stairs/ladder/elevator; icons + ghost use new single-icon art (no magenta); south facing; rotate N/E/**W**.
- **PASS 41:** FOOD/MEDICINE + Critical stockpile 2 gaps away → MOVE into Critical and stay. Regressions: chunks cross; equal-tier no-cross; designation gate; downward relay no stall; PUAH no loop; bill/surgery ingredient supplied cross-level.

## Status
2026-07-26: **GC micro-pass (#2/#4)** — audited hot paths; they were already boxing/LINQ-clean (indexed for over IReadOnlyList; HashSet/Dict/CellRect struct enumerators). #4 = no safe change (refused the fragile IReadOnlyList→List downcast); #2 = 3 safe warm-path LINQ removals (Hospitality AllComps.Any→for; PawnTable/AnimalTab MapByLevel.OrderByDescending→level walk). Green 0/0; lesson saved to perf lore. Earlier same day: refactor pass R1–R4 + R5 non-split; ARCHITECTURE.md + helicopter view; PASS 42 tier-1 gates; double stairs float-menu fix; MORTON art; ctrl+scroll nav; Workshop update 3767572810. **All post-PASS-42 work needs one in-game regression pass before publishing.**
